evidence.ACL: Mild delamination of the anterior cruciate ligament suggesting a remote low-grade partial tear/injury.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament is intact without tear.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: There is a complex tear of the medial meniscus with a longitudinal horizontal component involving the posterior horn and body extending to the anterior horn and inferior articular surface.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: The lateral meniscus and the lateral collateral ligament complex are intact without tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Moderate to severe diffuse chondral thinning at the medial tibiofemoral compartment with full-thickness involvement at the weightbearing surface with early subchondral bone marrow reactive changes along the tibial surface.
evidence.Lateral OA: Mild diffuse chondral thinning at the lateral tibiofemoral compartment with high-grade chondral fissures along the tibial surface
evidence.PF OA: Moderate to severe diffuse chondral thinning at the patellofemoral compartment with focal areas of severe chondropathy at the medial patellar facet, median ridge and lateral trochlea
